'''Willim''' was a [[Da'shain Aiel]] and one of three children of [[Jonai]] and [[Alnora]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Willim|comp}}

== History ==
He was fifteen when the Aiel began their journey to find a safe place at the beginning of the [[Breaking of the World|Breaking]]. He was sent away from the Aiel when he began to channel and could not stop. He had two siblings, [[Esole]] who died in a sickness at very young age and [[Adan]], who become the ancestor of [[Rand al'Thor]]. {{ref/book|4|26}}

==Errata==
He is listed as [[Jenn Aiel]] in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], but the term Jenn did not exist until decades after his death. He should be Da'shain Aiel.{{ref||comp}}
